title: Mark The Ball Take The Grab (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 134bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl harmonica fiddle aussie outback
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, the mark is the cleanest grab in football
Fifteen metres minimum kick, clean catch
Free kick from where you mark, the reward

[Verse 1]
The ball is kicked from a teammate or opponent
Fifteen metres of flight before it can be marked
Catch it cleanly without it touching the ground
Without being touched on the way, son, that is sound

[Pre-Chorus]
Hands up high, fingers spread wide
Eyes on the ball all the way, never hide
Body position under the flight
Absorb the catch, soft hands, hold tight

[Chorus]
Mark the ball take the grab, son
Fifteen metres clean, the work begun
Hands up high, soft into the chest
Free kick from the spot, the mark is best

[Verse 2]
Contested mark in a pack of bodies
Climb the ladder, ride the shoulders, no shoddies
Specky mark is the high flying grab
Knees on the back of the player, the dab

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, the screamer mark wins highlight reels
But the chest mark wins games on the deals
Go back and take the kick from the mark spot
No defender can touch you, son, hot spot

[Chorus]
Mark the ball take the grab, son
Fifteen metres clean, the work begun
Hands up high, soft into the chest
Free kick from the spot, the mark is best

[Outro]
Fifteen metres, hands up
Clean catch, no touch up
Free kick from the spot
Thats my boy, hit the slot
